searches.purpose: Locate archival identity, Berne primary works, theory and construct tests, treatment evidence, professional continuation, ethical safeguards and Spanish-language synthesis while excluding financial transaction analysis, linguistic transaction analysis, generic communication training and integrative treatments that merely cite TA

items.title: Eric Berne Archives: Our Mission
items.rights_note: Official description of the Berne collection held at UCSF and its provenance; the digitization project is supported by TA organizations and is not independent historiography.

items.title: Transactional Analysis in Psychotherapy: A Systematic Individual and Social Psychiatry
items.rights_note: Open Library record for the 1961 Grove Press edition; availability or preview links do not authorize caching or treating the book body as read.

items.title: Principles of Transactional Analysis
items.rights_note: Official Europe PMC XML record and abstract for a 1996 journal reprint of Berne's foundational presentation; the record explicitly points to a PDF-only body, so it is not treated as full-text reading or as a newly authored 1996 theory.
items.failure_note: The direct PMC PDF endpoint returned a 1.8 KB proof-of-work 'Preparing to download' page; it was removed and the official Europe PMC abstract record retained without solving or bypassing the challenge.

items.title: The Core Concepts of Transactional Analysis
items.rights_note: ITAA task-force statement approved in 2000 and redistributed in 2024; an internal consensus description of concepts, not independent empirical validation.

items.title: Use of the Transactional Analysis Ego State Concept to Measure Client Change in Psychotherapy
items.rights_note: Official Utah State University dissertation record and abstract reporting partial construct support and explicit limitations; copyright remains with the author, so the dissertation body is not cached or claimed as read.
items.failure_note: The preferred 1983 Williams et al. construct-validity publisher abstract returned HTTP 403 to the collector; this university dissertation record was selected without bypassing access controls.

items.title: The Evidence-Based Conceptual Model of Transactional Analysis: A Focused Review of the Research Literature
items.rights_note: Institutional repository abstract and bibliographic record, not the article body. The authors are TA practitioner-researchers and their broad evidence-based conclusion requires comparison with construct and outcome limitations.

items.title: The Effectiveness of Transactional Analysis Treatments and Their Predictors: A Systematic Literature Review and Explorative Meta-Analysis
items.rights_note: Author manuscript of a broad exploratory meta-analysis. It combines designs, populations, TA schools and outcomes, and its authors are practitioner-researchers; pooled effects must not be treated as indication-specific efficacy.

items.title: Ethical Code, Professional Practice Guidelines and Ethics Committee
items.rights_note: Current EATA/ITAA professional ethics and complaints guidance covering protection, confidentiality, exploitation and credential claims; it is not an adverse-event evidence review or clinical contraindication guideline.

items.title: Eficacia y efectividad del análisis transaccional para mejorar la autoestima, la resolución de problemas y las relaciones: una revisión sistemática
items.rights_note: CC BY-NC Spanish-language systematic review of selected psychosocial outcomes through 2023; publication language adds a translation boundary but does not by itself demonstrate cultural adaptation or cross-cultural equivalence.

items.title: International Transactional Analysis Association
items.rights_note: Current association self-description and certification activity; evidence of institutional continuation only, not proof of theoretical validity or treatment effectiveness.
